info.title: LocalMaxxing API
info.description: LocalMaxxing is a community speed test and benchmark platform for local LLM inference. Submit speed test results, query the leaderboard, syndicate marketplace ads, manage API keys, run evals, and fetch Train run bundles. For agent bootstrap context (enum values, examples, methodology tips) call GET /api/agent-context first.

BearerApiKey.description: API key with prefix `bhk_`. Obtain via POST /api/keys or the dashboard. Used for programmatic speed test and benchmark submission.

SessionCookie.name: authjs.session-token
SessionCookie.description: NextAuth session cookie. Used by the web UI.

gpus.description: For heterogeneous multi-GPU rigs. Use instead of gpuName/vramGb for rigs with mixed GPU models.

HardwareDiscreteGpu.description: NVIDIA / AMD / Intel discrete GPU. Provide either (gpuName + vramGb) or the gpus array — not both.

HardwareUnified.description: Apple Silicon / AMD APU / Intel Arc with shared memory architecture.

commandSnippet.description: Full engine launch command. LocalMaxxing auto-parses flags from this. Strongly recommended.

concurrency.description: Number of concurrent request slots (--concurrency, --max-running-requests, etc.).

numParallel.description: Alias for concurrency used by llama.cpp (--parallel).

gpuLayers.description: Number of layers to offload to GPU. Use -1 for full offload (llama.cpp --n-gpu-layers -1).

specMethod.description: Speculative decoding method (e.g. DFlash2, DFlash, ngram, draft_model, medusa).

specDraftTp.description: Tensor parallelism for the draft model.

specDraftWindowSize.description: DFlash / DFlash2 draft KV sliding-window size.

specDraftTokens.description: Total draft tokens proposed during the run.

specAcceptedTokens.description: Draft tokens accepted by the target model (<= specDraftTokens).

specMeanAcceptedLength.description: Mean tokens emitted per target forward pass; scales the decode ceiling for spec runs.

hfId.description: HuggingFace model repo ID. GGUF/AWQ/GPTQ package repos are allowed; put the actual quant string in the quantization field.

engineRepository.description: HTTP(S) source repository for the exact inference engine or fork used.

quantization.description: Quantization format of the model weights.

prefillTokens.description: Tokens already in KV cache before generation started (0 = cold start).

ttftMs.description: Time to first token in milliseconds.

tokSOut.description: Output tokens per second. Required. Plus at least one of ttftMs, tokSPrefill, tokSTotal, or peakVramGb must also be provided.

tokSPrefill.description: Prefill/input tokens per second before generation.

gpuPowerWatts.description: Measured power draw per GPU in watts — one entry per physical card. Supports heterogeneous multi-GPU rigs. Server computes totalPowerWatts as the sum.

hardwareCost.description: Self-reported purchase records. component must be a canonical hardware name from /api/agent-context hardwareOptions.hardwareCostComponentNames so costs can be filtered and linked. PATCH accepts null to clear.

promptSha256.description: SHA-256 of the prompt text WITHOUT the "[LocalMaxxing cache-bust nonce: …]" line. Must equal a canonical prompt hash for a Verified run.

promptSample.description: First 2000 chars of the request prompt (nonce line allowed; stripped server-side).

outputSha256.description: SHA-256 of the full generated text.

outputSample.description: Generated-text excerpt: first ~3000 chars + "\n…\n" + last ~1000 chars when longer.

engineTimingsRaw.description: Engine usage/timings object verbatim; <= 8 KiB serialized.

SpeedTestSubmit.description: tokSOut (output tok/s) is required. ttftMs, tokSPrefill, tokSTotal, and peakVramGb are optional. The server computes verifiedRun (boolean) and verificationIssues (string[]) from the evidence fields: a Verified run uses a canonical prompt (matching promptSha256 + promptSample), includes outputSample and engineTimingsRaw, has batchSize 1 / concurrency 1, outputTokens >= the prompt minimum (256), reports spec acceptance stats for spec/MTP runs, and does not exceed the hardware decode ceiling × 1.15.

oneOf.description: Bare score in [0, 1]. Shorthand for backward compatibility.

TaskResult.description: Per-task result. Either a bare score (0–1) or an object with score + optional metadata.

taskKey.description: Suite task key this artifact belongs to.

itemIndex.description: Zero-based question/sample index within the task.

attempt.description: Retry/attempt number for the same sample.

promptHash.description: Optional prompt hash. If omitted, server computes SHA-256 from prompt or objectRef metadata.

question.description: Public question text or preview shown to users. Include choices if relevant; do not include gold answers.

prompt.description: Rendered prompt or short preview. Required unless objectRef is supplied. Large full prompts should live in object storage.

response.description: Model response or short preview for this question. Large full responses should live in object storage.

testOutput.description: Runner, judge, or sandbox output preview.

latencyMs.description: Latency for this question in milliseconds.

EvalArtifactSubmit.description: Per-question model artifact submitted with an eval run. Include either prompt preview or objectRef. Large/full traces must be stored in artifactBundle or objectRef; Postgres stores only metadata and previews. Gold answers should not be included.

storageKey.description: Canonical object key in the LocalMaxxing eval data bucket.

url.description: Optional signed or public URL for retrieval when available.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 digest of the object contents.

itemCount.description: Number of samples/records in the object when known.

EvalDataStorageRef.description: Reference to bucket-backed eval data such as full trace bundles or datasets.

suiteSlug.description: Slug of the approved benchmark to submit against.

executionMode.description: Local execution mode. CUSTOM suites uploaded from the CLI require CUSTOM_LOCAL.

judgeMode.description: Judge provenance. For custom llm_judge uploads, omit judgeMode to request server-side judge scoring, or set LOCAL_REPORTED when providing local judge scores.

runConfig.description: Arbitrary run configuration metadata (temperature, few-shot count, etc.).

runnerVersion.description: Version of the eval runner used (e.g. lm-eval 0.4.3).

results.description: Map of every suite taskKey → score. Unknown keys and missing suite task keys are rejected. For custom llm_judge uploads that request server-side judging, this may be omitted and the server derives scores from artifacts.

artifacts.description: Optional per-question metadata/previews containing question, prompt, model response, score, latency, runner/test output, or objectRef pointers. Required for locally uploaded CUSTOM suites unless artifactBundle is supplied. Large/full traces must use artifactBundle or objectRef. Gold answers should not be included.

artifactBundle.description: Bucket-backed full eval trace/output bundle. Preferred for full prompt/response/judge traces.

slug.description: URL-safe identifier. Lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens. Immutable after creation.

runner.description: Evaluation type. LM_EVAL_HARNESS suites are run locally with lm-eval and submitted to /api/benchmarks/runs; CUSTOM suites are executed server-side through /api/benchmarks/execute.

sourceUrl.description: Link to the benchmark source or paper.

suiteDoc.description: Suite definition document. Schema validated by the server. Must define unique task keys. runner must match the top-level runner. Lower-is-better and perplexity suites are not supported yet.

EvalSuiteCreate.description: Suite creation requires admin approval before runs can be submitted against it (status starts as PENDING).

suiteSlug.description: Slug of an approved server-side CUSTOM benchmark.

model.description: HuggingFace model ID passed to the OpenAI-compatible server.

baseUrl.description: Public http/https OpenAI-compatible server base URL. Private/local/internal addresses are rejected.

autoSubmit.description: When true, creates a pending benchmark run after execution.

emoji.description: Emoji to react with (e.g. "👍"), or null to remove your reaction.

prefix.description: First 8 chars of the raw key for identification.

key.description: Full raw API key — returned ONCE at creation, never retrievable again.

modelLabel.description: Output model/checkpoint label when not linked to a catalogue model.

finetuneDetails.description: Method-specific details such as LoRA rank/alpha, target modules, epochs, or merge/export notes.

architecture.description: Architecture, optimizer, schedule, context length, parallelism, and other run-design details.

commitSha.description: Exact git commit to checkout after clone/branch checkout for reproducibility.

baseModel.description: Linked catalogue base model for finetunes, when present.

MarketplaceImage.description: Integration-safe LocalMaxxing image URLs. The underlying blob key and storage provider are intentionally hidden.

MarketplaceBenchmarkRun.description: Seller-linked proof-of-performance run, including model, engine, hardware, throughput, latency, power, cost, and run URL.

listingUrl.description: Canonical LocalMaxxing ad URL. Use as the primary partner-site click-through.

contactUrl.description: LocalMaxxing URL where a visitor can view the ad and contact the seller.

benchmark.description: The unmodified benchmark_results.json emitted by local-inference-lab/llm-inference-bench (metadata, prefill, results, burst_results, methodology). vLLM and SGLang reports are accepted; at most 2048 cells per decode layer; methodology ≤ 32 KiB. Server URLs, environment, event logs and samples are not stored.

engineVersion.description: The report has no engine version; send it here (vLLM GET /version, SGLang GET /get_server_info).

submittedWith.description: Client that produced the upload, e.g. "lmx v0.1.48 run". Shown, not verified.

status.description: CAPACITY_LIMITED cells were measured while requests queued. SKIPPED cells were not run because they exceed the server KV-cache budget (metadata.max_total_tokens). NOT_RUN cells are in the requested context × concurrency grid but missing from the report for another reason (skipped by hand or the run stopped early). LOOPED cells were discarded because the model repeated itself (loop_detected). ERROR cells had failed requests or no output. PREFIX_CACHED marks an overstated prefill (the server reused cached prompt tokens). SKIPPED, NOT_RUN, LOOPED and ERROR cells have tokS null. Matrices imported before LOOPED and NOT_RUN existed store loops as ERROR and have no cells for grid gaps.

tokS.description: Aggregate tok/s across all concurrent requests.

sourceModel.description: Served model name from the report.

details.description: Zod flatten() output on validation errors.

get.description: Returns everything an agent needs to construct a valid POST /api/speed-tests request: field schemas, accepted enum values, hardware sub-schemas, engine flags, examples, and methodology tips. Call this first before submitting. Cached 1 hour.
Returns the GFM syntax, LocalMaxxing extensions, limits, example payload, image protocol, editing endpoint, and publication lifecycle for agent-authored reports.

post.summary: Create a standardized GFM model report

tags.description: Lowercase discovery tags for the report.

get.description: Public, cross-origin syndication feed for displaying LocalMaxxing marketplace listings on partner sites. Returns absolute listing, contact, profile, image, thumbnail, and approved speed-test-run URLs while keeping direct seller contact instructions on LocalMaxxing. The feed contains active listings only; consumers that persist records must periodically reconcile a complete feed because deletions are not emitted as tombstones. No authentication required.

parameters.description: Maximum listings per page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque listing cursor returned as pagination.nextCursor.

parameters.name: updatedSince
parameters.description: Only active listings updated at or after this timestamp. Include an explicit timezone. This is an upsert aid, not a deletion stream.

200.description: Active marketplace listings ordered by most recently updated.

get.description: Returns the complete public syndication record for one active listing. No authentication required.

404.description: Listing does not exist or is not active.

post.description: Creates a new speed test run. Requires authentication via Bearer API key (Authorization: Bearer bhk_...) or a session cookie. Rate limited to 30 submissions per rolling hour per user (300 for Pro subscribers). Runs are approved immediately and appear on the leaderboard at once.

schema.description: Full speed test run record with related model, hardware, engine, and engine flags.

Retry-After.description: Seconds until the rate limit resets.

get.description: Returns approved speed test runs with optional filters. Public endpoint.

parameters.description: Filter by HuggingFace model ID.

parameters.name: modelId
parameters.description: Filter by internal model UUID.

parameters.name: gpuName

parameters.name: heterogeneousOnly

parameters.description: Only return runs with MTP enabled.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Return runs submitted on this UTC calendar day (YYYY-MM-DD). Mutually exclusive with dateFrom/dateTo.

parameters.name: dateFrom
parameters.description: Return runs submitted at or after this ISO-8601 timestamp. Composes with dateTo.

parameters.name: dateTo
parameters.description: Return runs submitted before this ISO-8601 timestamp. Composes with dateFrom.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Filter by internal user ID. Overrides the verified filter.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Filter by public username (case-insensitive). Overrides the verified filter. Ignored when userId is also provided.

parameters.name: mine
parameters.description: Return all runs owned by the authenticated caller, including pending and rejected submissions.

200.description: Paginated list of speed test runs.

post.description: Validates a speed test submission without writing to the database and without consuming the rate limit. Requires Bearer API key or session cookie. Returns the normalized/defaulted payload on success plus a structural Verified-run check (decode ceiling is only enforced on submit).

400.description: Invalid JSON, validation failure, or missing performance metrics.

get.description: Pass exactly one selector. Public selectors (hfId, hardwareGroup, username) return approved matrices only, newest first, limit 1–20 (default 10). hfId returns { runs } (unknown models return an empty list). hardwareGroup (the group key used by hardware pages, e.g. hardwareGroupKey on GET /api/leaderboard rows) and username return { runs, total }. mine=true requires authentication and returns the caller's matrices in every status as { runs, total, limit, offset } (limit ≤ 100, default 20).

parameters.name: gpus
parameters.description: With hardwareGroup: only rigs with exactly this many GPUs.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: mine=true only.

total.description: Present for hardwareGroup, username and mine=true.

post.description: Imports a complete local-inference-lab/llm-inference-bench JSON report as one matrix: prefill plus sustained and burst decode across context lengths × concurrency. Shares the speed-test hourly quota. A matrix with any decode cell above 10× the memory-bandwidth decode ceiling is stored as SUSPICIOUS (hidden until an admin approves it); otherwise it is APPROVED immediately.

409.description: The same report was already imported.

post.description: Runs the full import inside a transaction that is rolled back. Nothing is stored and no quota is consumed. Returns the same errors as the real import.

409.description: The same report was already imported.

get.description: Approved matrices are public. Held (SUSPICIOUS) matrices are visible to their owner and admins only; anyone else gets 404.

patch.description: Metadata only; measurements cannot be edited and unknown fields are rejected. Owners may edit within 24 hours of submission, once every 5 minutes; admins bypass both and may set status. Changing hfId, quantization, hardware or commandSnippet re-runs the plausibility review. Add ?dryRun=true to preview without saving.

403.description: Not owner/admin, or edit window closed.

delete.description: Permanently deletes the matrix and its cells. Owner or admin.

get.description: Compatibility listing for /api/speed-tests. Public callers receive approved runs. Pass mine=true with a Bearer API key or session cookie to include all submissions owned by the caller.

get.summary: List a user’s speed test runs
get.description: Returns approved runs for the requested username. When the authenticated caller owns that username, their pending and rejected submissions are included with status.

patch.description: Edits a speed test run owned by the authenticated user. Admins may edit any run. Non-admin edits are limited to 24 hours after submission with a 5-minute cooldown.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Speed test run ID.

403.description: Not owner/admin, or edit window closed.

delete.description: Deletes a speed test run owned by the authenticated user. Admins may delete any run.

parameters.description: Speed test run ID.

reactionCounts.description: Map of emoji → count after the update.

get.description: Returns approved speed test runs ranked by output tok/s descending. Supports filtering by model, hardware class, memory tier, engine, quantization, and date range. Public endpoint.

parameters.name: hfId
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on model HF ID (e.g. Qwen/Qwen3-8B).

parameters.name: modelId
parameters.description: Alias for hfId — case-insensitive substring filter on model HF ID.

parameters.name: memTier
parameters.description: VRAM / unified memory tier in GB.

parameters.name: verified
parameters.description: Filter by submitter verified status.

parameters.name: verifiedRun
parameters.description: Only runs that passed canonical-prompt verification. Rows include verifiedRun, verificationIssues, promptSha256, promptSample, outputSample and engineFlags spec acceptance stats.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Omit for all-time.

parameters.name: hardwareName
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring search across all hardware types. For DISCRETE_GPU/UNIFIED runs matches gpuName, chipFamily, chipVariant, chipVendor. For CPU_ONLY runs matches cpu, chipFamily, chipVariant, chipVendor. Replaces the old gpuName filter. Composes freely with hwClass.

parameters.name: paramSize
parameters.description: Filter by model parameter size tier (billions). Ranges: 1=<3B, 3=3–7B, 7=7–13B, 13=13–30B, 30=30–70B, 70=70–110B, 110=≥110B. Uses the size in the model repo name when present (e.g. Qwen3-0.6B → 0.6), else model.params.

parameters.name: os
parameters.description: Filter by operating system of the hardware profile (case-insensitive).

parameters.name: backend
parameters.description: Exact match on engine backend (e.g. cuda, rocm, metal, vulkan, xpu, cpu, openvino).

parameters.name: modelFamily
parameters.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on model family name.

parameters.name: isMoE
parameters.description: Filter to Mixture-of-Experts models (true) or dense models (false).

parameters.name: batchSize
parameters.description: Filter by batch size. Value 8 matches batch size ≥ 8.

parameters.name: contextLen
parameters.description: Filter by context length bucket. Each value covers a range up to the next tier.

200.description: Ranked leaderboard rows with reaction counts.

myEmoji.description: Authenticated user's reaction emoji, or null.
